dogecoin.text: @Kona1Kev @TOtis1959 @dogecoin_empire Then you surround yourself with good men. Sadly, some men I thought were genuinely good men were found to have been entertaining women other than their wives on the side. It’s hard to not get bitter when even the men you trust implicitly let you down.

@TOtis1959 @Kona1Kev @dogecoin_empire Some men can be loyal for a time but when opportunity and temptation present themselves, the majority will partake. Most men don’t love their wives; they marry the one they want to take care of things and free up time for him to do what and whom he pleases.

@Kona1Kev @dogecoin_empire It’s what I thought, too. Men will marry the one on the right. She’ll do everything for him and will be neglected. They’ll cheat with the one on the left and she’ll get all of his time, affection, energy, and effort. Tale as old as time.
